questions.stem: A 28-year-old female presents to the clinic, reporting that she is late for her period by one day. She has been married for 4 years and has 2 children. She has no significant gynecological history. She has had regular periods. Her urine pregnancy test is negative. She is advised to wait for another few days and gets her period the next day. Which mechanism is responsible for menstrual bleeding in the absence of pregnancy?

options.label: A
options.text: The involution of the corpus luteum causes estradiol and progesterone levels to fall dramatically.

options.label: C
options.text: Estradiol levels are not involved in the LH surge phenomenon

options.label: D
options.text: Estradiol inhibits the induction of the progesterone receptor in the endometrium
